<!-- main-issue519-completion-20260918 -->
The named proof obligation is complete on main. It now lives as
[`tildeM_consistent_pointMeas'_ofGlobalPairWitness`](https://github.com/Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-A/blob/57798477c56b16b99282a4a056b8af66f3799185/MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SuppliedPointConsistency.lean#L226).
The explicit suffix documents the witness premise already present in this
issue's original statement. The universal constant, parameter order, domain
`0 <= epsilon <= 1`, `0 <= deltaG`, supplied `GlobalPairWitness`, point average
and `deltaConstructPaulis` conclusion are unchanged.

Fresh transitive axiom queries on 2026-09-17 returned only `propext`,
`Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound` for this theorem,
`exists_pulled_apart_consistency` and `exists_globalPairWitness`. The checked
worktree was based on `57798477`; MAIN verified that all Lean and toolchain
inputs match published main `d5d084aa`. Its sole local change, `b989145a`, is a
docstring correction, with no statement, proof or import change. The probe,
verbatim output and eight verified artifact hashes are archived in
`results/telemetry/native-audits/pr539-docstring-01a0b06f/terminal.jsonl`.

There are no open sub-issues. Closing this proof packet does not close the
remaining extraction obligations tracked by #123. PR #539 remains open for
separate retirement after its small documentation replacement completes the
normal publication/review path; its original branch and historical records
are preserved. No new proof attempt or budget reset was used for this closure.
